info.name: PhantomPermissionMCP Scenarios
info.description:
Step 61 — repeatable positive and negative API scenarios for the full v1 lifecycle.

Run with Newman against a live local stack (Docker Compose):
  newman run postman/PhantomPermissionMCP-Scenarios.postman_collection.json \n    --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:3000 \n    --env-var api_key=ppk_...

Required environment variables: baseUrl, api_key (full-scope key).
Optional (scenarios skip gracefully when unset):
- api_key_readonly — key with only models:read (scope-denial scenario).
- other_tenant_model_id — a model id from ANOTHER tenant (tenant-isolation scenario; falls back to an unknown id).
- run_rate_limit — set to true to enable the rate-limit burst scenario (off by default so the suite stays fast and does not poison the rate budget).

Every run creates a fresh model/simulation with test-generated ids; no hard-coded keys or shared state.
